## File Map
- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\App.jsx`  
  Main shell wiring: opens Mission Control, Operator Inbox, Workpad, Calendar/Deadlines, Mission Scheduler, Trust Strip, Readiness Verdict, slash commands, hotkeys, and overlay mounting.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\OperatorCalendarDrawer.jsx`  
  Current deadline-first calendar surface. Uses local deadlines plus Workpad due tasks. This is the most direct ChronoHUD predecessor.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\lib\deadlines.js`  
  Local deadline store: `neuralshell_deadlines_v1`, `neuralshell:deadlines-changed`, ICS export, Google/Outlook links, Workpad deadline sync.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\lib\workpadStore.js`  
  Per-workflow Workpad storage and events: notes, tasks, pins, capture log, scoped keys, `neuralshell:workpad-changed`.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\Workpad\WorkpadPanel.jsx`  
  Full Workpad UI. Adds tasks with due dates and can sync tasks into deadlines.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TaskManagerDrawer.jsx`  
  Operator Inbox. Tabs include Operations, Actions, Workpad, Health, Missions. It already surfaces Workpad task counts and scheduled missions.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MissionControl.jsx`  
  Runtime cockpit overlay. Good integration point for “today’s top operator items” or a ChronoHUD launch button.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\MissionScheduler.jsx`  
  NodeChain mission scheduler. Stores schedules under `neuralshell_nodechain_mission_schedules_v1`.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\runtime\nodechain\missions\missionEngine.ts`  
  Mission schedule/history engine.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\bootstrap\operatorPalette.js` and `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\CommandPalette.jsx`  
  Command Palette registration and UI. Existing commands open Inbox, Workpad, Calendar, Guided Actions, Trust Report, health check.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TopStatusBar.jsx`  
  Live clock/date button opens Calendar & Deadlines. ChronoHUD should preserve this entry point.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\TrustStrip.jsx`  
  Top trust/readiness strip. Shows readiness badge and trust severity. Could later show next critical time event.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\components\ReadinessVerdictModal.jsx`, `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\lib\deriveReadinessVerdict.js`, `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\lib\deriveShellTrustState.js`  
  Existing readiness verdict logic. ChronoHUD should consume this status, not redefine it.

- `c:\Users\KickA\Documents\GitHub\NeuralShell\src\renderer\src\lib\shellMaturity.js`  
  Stable/pilot/experimental/internal gating. Important if ChronoHUD ships default while add-ons remain gated.

## MVP Integration Advice
Use `OperatorCalendarDrawer.jsx` as the MVP replacement target, but keep its existing entry points: top clock, `/calendar`, `/deadlines`, `Ctrl+Shift+C`, and palette “Open Calendar & Deadlines”. Add `/chrono` only as an alias.

Keep ChronoHUD data local and compatible: reuse `deadlines.js` for deadlines and `workpadStore.js` for Workpad tasks. If adding events/reminders/sessions, put them in new local stores instead of changing the deadline shape.

Do not break existing test IDs on shared surfaces: `trust-strip`, `readiness-verdict-badge`, `operator-inbox-drawer`, `operator-calendar-drawer` or its replacement path, `mission-control`, `mission-scheduler`, and palette IDs.

First integration should be small:
- Replace/focus the Calendar & Deadlines drawer with ChronoHUD.
- Show deadlines, Workpad due tasks, today timeline, and next critical item.
- Add a Command Palette command/focus path.
- Add a Mission Control launch button or compact “today” card.
- Display existing readiness verdict status inside the HUD.
- Defer Trust Strip mutation until selectors are stable.

Suggested validation targets: `e2e/workpad.spec.js`, `e2e/missionControl.spec.js`, `e2e/missionScheduler.spec.js`, `e2e/shellMaturityGates.spec.js`, plus new `e2e/chronoHud.spec.js` and `tear/chrono-hud.test.js`.
